extName.message: Companion for YouTube Music - Mini Player

locale.description: This catalog's language code; it picks the plural rules. Set it to the folder name.

extDescription.message: Control YouTube Music from a toolbar popup: playback, queue, albums, recommendations, history, search, playlists and synced lyrics.

cmdPlayPause.message: Play or pause the current track

cmdLike.message: Like or unlike the current track

cmdDislike.message: Dislike or un-dislike the current track

nothingPlayingSub.message: Search or pick a playlist to get going

queueEmptyHint.message: Nothing in the queue. Try Start radio from the ⋯ menu.

signInLike.message: Sign in to YouTube Music to like songs.

signInRate.message: Sign in to YouTube Music to rate songs.

signInLibrary.message: Sign in to YouTube Music to use your library.

signInPlaylists.message: Sign in to YouTube Music to save to playlists.

copyQueueEmpty.message: Nothing in the queue to copy.

copyQueueNoLinks.message: The queue has no links to copy yet. Try again in a moment.

copyQueueHeader_one.description: First line of the copied tracklist. Keep the leading # and the space after it; the import skips lines that start with them.

importReplaceCount.description: Armed state of the import button; the question mark is what marks it as a confirmation.

queueReplacedPartial.message: Queue replaced - $COUNT$ of $ASKED$, the rest are unavailable.

sleepRange.message: Set a timer between 1 and $MAX$ minutes.

historyFailed.message: Couldn’t load history from YouTube Music.

historySignIn.message: Sign in to YouTube Music to see your history.

historyEmpty.message: No history yet. Songs you play will show up here.

homeFailed.message: Couldn’t load recommendations from YouTube Music.

homeSignIn.message: Sign in to YouTube Music to see recommendations.

playlistsFailedRequest.message: Couldn’t load playlists from YouTube Music. (request failed)

playlistsFailedTimeout.message: Couldn’t load playlists from YouTube Music. (timed out)

playlistsSignIn.message: Sign in to YouTube Music to see your playlists.

playlistsEmpty.message: No playlists in your library yet.

lyricsOptIn.message: Lyrics are looked up on lrclib.net using the track’s title and artist.

lyricsUnreachable.message: Couldn’t reach the lyrics service. It’ll retry on the next play.

lyricsNotFound.message: No lyrics found for this track.

lyricsSongsOnly.message: Lyrics are available for official songs only.

setLyricsSub.message: Looks up title & artist on lrclib.net

setStatusDotSub.message: Green playing, yellow paused on the icon

setAccentIconSub.message: Tint the icon to match your accent

setDislikeSub.message: Show it next to like in the player

setRowQueueSub.message: On rows, and whole albums and playlists

setRowRadioSub.message: On search, history and playlist rows

shortcutChipHint.message: Click, then press a combination. Backspace clears, Esc cancels.

shortcutNeedsModifier.message: Shortcuts need Ctrl, Alt or Command plus a regular key.

shortcutNotAllowed.message: $COMBO$ isn’t allowed as a shortcut. Try Ctrl/Alt (+Shift) + a key.

rateText.message: Enjoying Companion? A rating helps others find it.

emptySub.message: Open it in a tab and this popup becomes your player.

emptyAccessSub.message: The browser needs your permission before this extension can control your YouTube Music tab and load lyrics.

emptyAsleepTitle.message: Your YouTube Music tab is asleep

emptyAsleepSub.message: The browser only loads it once you open it.

emptyWakingSub.message: Your tab was unloaded, giving it a nudge.

emptyReloadSub.message: The tab is open but can’t hear the extension - this happens after an update. One reload reconnects it.

noticeAutoplayBlocked.message: Playback was blocked by the browser. Allow autoplay for music.youtube.com, or press play in the tab once.

noticeRadioFailed.message: Couldn’t start a radio for this song. Try again.

noticePlayFailed.message: Couldn’t play that song. Try again.

noticeReorderAutoplay.message: That row can’t be reordered. Autoplay suggestions stay put.

noticeQueueAddFailed.message: Couldn’t add that song to the queue.

noticeMoveFailed.message: Couldn’t move that song. Try again.

noticeRateFailed.message: Couldn’t rate that song. Try again.

noticeQueueUpFailed.message: Couldn’t queue that up. Try again.

noticeQueueUpScroll.message: Couldn’t queue that up. Scroll to the end of the playlist, then try again.

noticeImportAppendFailed.message: Started the first track, but the rest couldn’t be added. Try again.

noticeRemoveFailed.message: Couldn’t remove that song. Try again.
